drop.title: VPN dropped
status.enterPath: Enter a file path first, or click Choose file...

otp.hint: Used only for this connection and never saved. The saved password is unchanged.
cfg.name: Name
cfg.passwordSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it
cfg.split.title: Split tunnel
cfg.split.on: Only traffic for the VPN's own network goes through it.
cfg.split.off: All internet traffic goes through the VPN.
cfg.dns.title: Use DNS from the VPN
cfg.dns.off: DNS from the VPN is ignored.
cfg.auto.title: Connect automatically
cfg.auto.on: Connects by itself when the network is up, and reconnects if it drops.
